item.title: The Ellie Beach Resort Appoints Kaitlyn Lofgren as Director of Food & Beverage
item.description: The Ellie Beach Resort, a new Tapestry Collection by Hilton property on Myrtle Beach’s historic Springmaid Beach, announces the appointment of Kaitlyn Lofgren as director of food and beverage.

item.title: Hollings Announces Re-Election Campaign for Register of Deeds
item.description: Charleston County Register of Deeds Karen Hollings today announced she will seek a second term in 2026 as a Democrat.

item.title: Comedy Legends Steve Martin and Martin Short Return to the North Charleston PAC in December
item.description: Steve Martin and Martin Short on Tuesday announced winter 2026 dates for “The Best of Steve Martin and Martin Short” tour. The new tour includes a stop at the North Charleston Performing Arts Center on Friday, Dec. 4.

item.title: Charleston Police Launch a New Training Program for Trauma Informed Investigations
item.description: The Charleston Police Department has launched a new training initiative focused on trauma informed investigations after receiving the Abby Honold Grant.

item.title: Logan’s Roadhouse Launches Spring Limited-Time Menu With Seasonal Seafood and Lent-Friendly Options
item.description: Logan’s Roadhouse, known for its mesquite wood-grilled steaks, famous scratch-made rolls and warm hospitality, will introduce a new limited-time menu for spring beginning Feb. 23.

item.title: Addressing Storm Damage on Commercial Properties
item.description: Storm damage represents a serious threat to the longevity and safety of any business facility. High winds, heavy rain, and hail can compromise a structure in minutes. Property owners must act quickly to evaluate the condition of their buildings. Waiting too long to address these issues often leads to much higher repair costs later.

Dorchester County, MUSC Health, and Local Partners Open New Health Care Facility in St. George
item.description: Today, February 23, 2026, Dorchester County leaders celebrated the opening of MUSC Health Primary Care, a single-story 6,336-square-foot health care facility that will serve St. George and the surrounding communities.

item.title: Reverend Jesse Jackson, Sr. to Lie in State at South Carolina Statehouse
item.description: At the request of the Jackson family and numerous members of the South Carolina General Assembly, the body of the Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr. will lie in state at the South Carolina Statehouse on Monday, March 2, 2026, the Governor’s Office announced

item.title: Temporary closure of Woodland Shores Road planned as part of ongoing improvements
item.description: Woodland Shores Road will temporarily close to traffic between Riverland Drive and Maybank Highway Wednesday, February 25 through Friday, February 27, as crews install improved stormwater drainage infrastructure
